data_source.real: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients (Yeh & Lien 2009)
data_source.synthetic_method: segment-conditional bootstrap: KMeans(16) on real rows; resample members with replacement; jitter continuous dims only (~5% of std); discrete dims copied exactly; all dims clipped to real p1/p99 (heavy tails winsorized, disclosed); tenure conditioned on age; Indian city mix with documented prior multipliers; labels from real-fitted HGB teacher + 2% flip noise

fairness_note: Demo model; tuned to catch potential defaults, so some flags will be incorrect. Retrained without age/city_risk for fairness; age and city must be reviewed/removed before real-world lending decisions.
selection_criterion: max PR-AUC on REAL select split (average precision; robust to imbalance)
threshold_rule: max F2 (beta=2, missing a default costs more than a false alarm) on REAL select

feature_notes.credit_capacity: UCI LIMIT_BAL (credit limit, income-correlated) | app avg_income_6m. Different units; pipeline z-scores both.
feature_notes.loan_amount: UCI LIMIT_BAL as exposure proxy | app requested_amount.
feature_notes.age: UCI AGE | app age. Direct match, no proxy.
feature_notes.dpd_mean: UCI mean(PAY_*) | app avg_delay_days/30 (may be negative).
feature_notes.utilization: UCI mean(BILL)/LIMIT | app avg_debt_6m / max(6*avg_income_6m,1), clipped 0..3.
feature_notes.tenure_months: Absent from UCI (NaN, median-imputed) | app tenure_months. Learned mostly from synthetic rows.
feature_notes.city_risk: Absent from UCI (NaN) | app target-encoded city default prior fitted on TRAIN ONLY. City effect comes from the synthetic prior; reported as weak by design.
feature_notes.ontime_rate: UCI #(PAY_*<0)/6 | app ontime_streak_months/max(ontime+late+1,1) blended with salary_credits_6m/6.

ablation_comparison.why: Age and city removed for fairness; kept iff metrics held.

ablated_14feat_rf_test_real_NOT_SHIPPED.reason: 178MB artifact + 1.8s/row SHAP vs 0.6MB HGB; +0.002 PR-AUC not worth it

ablation_comparison.verdict: No measurable difference (dPR-AUC +0.001, dROC -0.001): fairness gain at no cost. Fair HGB shipped.
